candidate_sentence_map.S1: AS Trigon Property Development reported a substantial deterioration in performance in 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: The company generated no property sales, compared with €331,920 of sales revenue in 2024, including a €300,000 sale in the fourth quarter and a €31,920 sale in the third quarter.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: Consequently, gross profit fell from €220,299 in 2024 to zero, and the operating result changed from a €161,649 profit to a €108,021 loss.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: After €8,513 of financial income, compared with €5,760 in 2024, the company recorded a net loss of €99,507, versus a net profit of €167,409 in the previous year.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Fourth-quarter results also weakened, with a net loss of €23,333 compared with a net profit of €154,215 in the fourth quarter of 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: Administrative and general expenses increased to €108,021 from €63,650.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: The increase included remuneration for the Management and Supervisory Boards and higher professional-service costs.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: The company continued to operate as a single-segment real estate developer and owned one development project in Pärnu.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: No land plots were sold during 2025, while €91,262 was invested in the project.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: Total assets decreased to €1,804,656 and equity declined to €1,755,267 following the annual loss.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: The number of shares remained unchanged at 4,499,061.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: Earnings per share fell from €0.03721 to -€0.02212, while the year-end share price increased modestly from €0.620 to €0.634.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: The company’s 2025 interim report was unaudited.
